cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Thanks for the lift. I'll cover your Saturday shift. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No need. I covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then I'll take your whole weekend. You shouldn't be doing more than me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already swapped Sunday to drive you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll cancel my flight and cover your holiday. You deserve the longer break.

mechanism: A manages a reciprocal favor schedule but keeps accommodating B existing sacrifices by proposing still larger ones under a confident fairness plan.
confusable: Unlike ordinary reciprocity, A must regain the lead after each B contribution; authority relies on B allowing the ever bigger arrangement.
comparison: Coworker shifts and airport sacrifice differ from food storage and care during illness.
seedUse: Use D43-b lift/shift/weekend/airport chain with S02-b adapting the form of a demand to preserve participation.
